meta.title: Provod spending
meta.description: Adds a "Spending" entry to the sidebar panel list: the account balance (exact when a regular PROVOD_API_KEY is present, otherwise a credits-minus-usage estimate), today and month-to-date totals, a month-end forecast, spending by day, a bar breakdown by model with a top-10 table and a "Show all" button, and model efficiency (input cache hits, error share, response time, speed and price per million tokens). Requires a Provod workspace management key: paste it into the page's "Key" section (it is kept in the DSH credential store) or set PROVOD_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY. Each refresh makes up to five requests to api.provod.ai from this machine — balance or credits, two model queries and hourly rows — and sends only the keys and date ranges; the keys themselves never reach the browser. Spending is grouped by booking time while request counts are grouped by completion time, so averages and the forecast are approximate; Provod limits analytics to 2 requests per second and 30 per minute. Turning the plugin off removes the page and the routes; no Session data is read or changed.
